title: CWP/24976/2023 of ARSHDEEP KAUR Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND ANOTHER
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 237 CWP-24976-2023 (O & M) Date of decision:12.05.2025 Arshdeep Kaur ....Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and others ...Respondents CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE AMAN CHAUDHARY Present : Mr. Rakesh Verma, Advocate, for the petitioner. Mr. Manipal Singh Atwal, DAG, Punjab. AMAN CHAUDHARY, J. (ORAL)

1. Prayer made in the present petition is for directing the respondents to consider the petitioner for promotion to the post of Clerk Grade-3.

2. Learned State counsel refers to the averments made in para 5 of preliminary submissions of reply filed on behalf of respondents No.1 and 2, dated 09.01.2024, to state that the petitioner cleared the type test on 08.12.2020, however, her 5 years’ experience was completed on 05.10.2021 and as such, at that point in time, could not have been considered, while in para 7, it is stated that as and when the promotions will be made by the department in future, her case would be considered in accordance with applicable rules, which satisfies the learned counsel for the petitioner.

3. Disposed of accordingly. 12.05.2025 (AMAN CHAUDHARY) parveen kumar JUDGE integrity of this order/judgment.
